This is a story which takes place in a world slightly different from the current reality...

As a result of the declining birthrate and falling population,, the Japanese government has come up with a plan which is to be implemented at every educational facility in the country..."Operation Orgy Practical".

Yamamoto Hifumi has to choose one of his beloved classmates to carry out this "practical training" with...

translation:
这是一个发生在与现实稍有不同的世界的故事……

由于少子化和人口减少，日本政府提出了一项将在全国所有教育机构实施的计划……“狂欢实践行动”。

山本一富美必须选择一位他心爱的同学来进行这次“实战训练”……
